senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.(b. h. חַוְרָן, v. Wetzst. to Delitzsch Job p. 597, cmp. חָרַר) Havran, Auran, a signal station, for proclaiming the New-Moon, in the country east of the Jordan named Auranitis.
units: R. Hash. II, 4 (22ᵇ) (Mish. Pes. חורון, Mish. Nap. חברון; Ms. O. חורון); Tosef. ib. II (I), 2 (Var. חַוְרָן).—(בְּרַת) בֵּית ח׳ Beth- (Brath-) Havran, prob. the same place.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:14">Y. Shek. I, 46ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:2:8">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>ר׳ חונייה דב׳ ח׳</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 3b:11">M. Kat. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ נחוניא איש בקעת בית חֲוַרְתָּן</he> (Ms. M. <he>בקעת חוו׳</he>); <cite ref="Sukkah 34a">Succ. 34ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (missing in ed.).
